raw_record.question_text: The bee on the right has a few pieces missing. Each piece costs points (Punkte). How many points does Maya need to complete the bee?

method.method_draft: Compare the complete bee on the left with the incomplete bee on the right, then use the point-price legend in the middle. From the image, note that the right bee already has the body, stripes, stinger, left wing, one eye, and one antenna, but is missing the second eye, the opposite antenna, the right-side wing outline, and the smiling mouth. Match these missing parts to the legend: eye = 1 point, antenna = 3 points, right-side wing shape = 4 points, smile/mouth = 5 points. Add the costs: 1 + 3 + 4 + 5 = 13 points.
